## Changes for Schedule I 0.4.7f6

- Fixed custom phone contacts being rejected after returning to the menu and loading again when their avatar body was culled. Fixes [#319](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/319).
- Fixed duplicate Messages entries for custom contacts on the first load. Existing conversations and message history are retained through network initialization. Fixes [#327](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/327).
- Client contacts now update their conversation registration after network spawn. Rebinding also restores missing registrations and preserves entries owned by other contacts.
- Added opt-in external hosting for phone and TV apps. Apps can create independent display sessions without moving their original device UI. `ExternalAppCatalog.Refresh(host)` updates hosting eligibility, and the icon resolver includes file icons and sprites selected through `SetIconSprite`. See [PR #328](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/328).

## Compatibility and validation

Existing public signatures, NPC save identifiers, and network payload formats are unchanged. External hosting is additive and requires app opt-in.

The combined candidate passed 740 Mono and 720 IL2CPP contract tests. The original contact fixes also passed live first-load, menu-reload, and saved-reload checks on both runtimes. Review follow-ups have build and contract coverage; additional live icon and two-peer checks were interrupted before their feature assertions and are not claimed as passing.

This is a GitHub-only prerelease for the game beta. It does not publish to NuGet, Nexus Mods, or Thunderstore.
